svg.title: Seconds of boost, hours of refill: the reported cold-gas system on an illustrative Roadster x-ray sketch
svg.desc: An illustrative x-ray sketch of a Roadster-style coupe with the reported cold-gas components called out: external nitrogen supply, COPV tank, regulator and valves, and rear nozzles, with a dashed refill loop. Component placement is illustrative, from public reports, not Tesla drawings. Reported durations: about five seconds of boost and a two-to-six-hour refill for the 200-liter Thrust (InsideEVs); a six-to-seven-hour refill for the 600-liter Rocket (WIRED), boost duration not reported. A dashed modeled strip computes about 114.3 kilograms per second and about 571 kilograms of gas from 80,000 newtons, 700 meters per second, and five seconds — inputs from separate reports, not one measured configuration.
svg.text: Sketch illustrative — not Tesla drawings · hours compressed
